Choose Other Styles View More Description This soft area rug features a striking western running horse design, making it a beautiful and unique addition to your home decor. Crafted to bring a comfortable feeling to the touch, this rug helps soothe tired feet and shields toes from cold floors. It is designed to fit naturally into various rooms, providing both a decorative accent and a cozy underfoot cushion. Product Highlights Vibrant western running horse pattern printed with premium heat dye sublimation for long-lasting color. Personalized DIY printing design allows for custom options to match your home decor. Soft memory foam and sponge interlayer offer a plush cushion that effectively relieves foot pressure. Equipped with a high-quality non-slip backing for extra durability and secure placement. Constructed with tear-resistant polyester and reinforced serged edges to ensure long-term use. Low-profile pile height of 4mm makes it perfect for placing under furniture in busy spaces.
